source.title: Una inscripción ibérica sobre plomo procedente del poblado de la Moleta del Remei (Alcanar, Montsià, Tarragona)

archaeological_context: Ámbito A52; two physical areas differentiated on a damaged, partly melted lead fragment

editorial_observations.zone1_line1: Three signs visible at right edge, first partial; s possible, ka variant
editorial_observations.zone1_line2: Nine signs; last five comparatively clearer; iltun candidate
editorial_observations.zone2_line1: At least nine remains; multiple highly ambiguous signs

interpretation: Source verifies three lines in two physical areas, not coordinates of each sign. Seven detected ink bands are artifact-derived and do not equal seven text rows.
